fields.text: Our latest case study is live — how Copperfield Group increased leads by 40%. Link in bio.
New podcast episode: how we reduced CAC by 30% with content-led growth. Listen here →
RT @company: We just hit 10,000 customers! Thank you to everyone who believed in us from day one.
Great insights from @marketingpro on demand gen. Worth a read for any B2B marketer.
March content calendar is locked. 8 blog posts, 4 videos, 2 webinars. Let's go! 🚀
3 underrated email marketing tactics that boosted our open rates by 20%: Thread 🧵
Excited to announce our new content marketing playbook! Download the free guide: https://t.co/example1
Hot take: gated content is dead for top-of-funnel. Ungated builds trust faster.
Anyone else seeing LinkedIn organic reach drop? Our impressions are down 25% MoM.
Attending @MarketingConf next month. Who else will be there? DM me to connect!
